title: Raccoon waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <ellipse cx='29' cy='72' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#8a90a8' transform='rotate(-12 29 72)'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='21' ry='15' fill='#eef0f8'/>

  <circle cx='30' cy='52' r='3' fill='#f2a8b8' opacity='0.8'/>
